name: Battle Cards
tagline: A one-page, rep-ready competitive card: the 3 moves that win the deal, a proof-backed fight, and objection handling.
who: Sales teams and founders selling against named competitors who need a card a rep can scan in the minute before a call.
how: Name the competitor and the agent researches the matchup — reusing its Living Competitive Intel brief when one exists — and delivers the card as a one-page doc: the 3 winning moves, the 5–6 fight rows that decide the deal (including honest parity), if-they-say/you-say objection handling, and your own landmines pre-answered. Every claim is sourced and dated or visibly flagged; the card stays under a page because a shorter card a rep actually reads beats a complete card nobody opens. Segment cuts by industry, geo, or size on request.
